containersSubtitle: Containers run directly by Podman on this host. They are separate from Kubernetes Pods.
detailSubtitle: Podman container on this host (not managed by Kubernetes).
envMasked: Values of variables with sensitive names (PASSWORD, SECRET, TOKEN, KEY) are hidden.
logsNoLive: Podman: the last log lines are shown (use Reload to refresh). Live streaming is available for Kubernetes Pods.

stop.title: Stop container {{name}}?
consequences: The process receives SIGTERM and, after 10 seconds, SIGKILL.
The service provided by the container is unavailable until it is started again.

restart.title: Restart container {{name}}?
consequences: The container is stopped and started again: open connections are dropped.
Downtime lasts as long as the application start-up.

remove.title: Remove container {{name}}?
consequences: The container and its writable filesystem are permanently deleted.
remove.force: Force removal even if running (stops it)

runtime.title: Runtime: Podman
runtime.notKubernetes: This section manages the Podman runtime of this host through its API. It is not Kubernetes: the containers listed here are not cluster Pods.

imagesSubtitle: Images in the local Podman storage of this host.
danglingHelp: Image without a name (dangling): usually a replaced previous version that can be removed.
onboardingHelp: Analyse the image and publish it to Kubernetes with the guided procedure
referenceHint: Full name with registry and tag, for example docker.io/library/nginx:1.27 or container-registry.oracle.com/os/oraclelinux:9-slim.
pulling: Downloading: large images may take a few minutes…
removeImageConsequences: The image is deleted from local storage.
It can be pulled again from the registry if still available.
forceImage: Force removal even if used by containers (also removes those containers)
registriesSubtitle: Image registries used by Podman on this host.
registriesExplain: A registry is the server container images are downloaded from (for example docker.io, quay.io, container-registry.oracle.com or a company registry). When an image name does not specify the registry, Podman looks it up in the search registries in the order shown.
registriesK8sNote: Note: this configuration applies to Podman on this host. Kubernetes nodes pull images with their own runtime and credentials (imagePullSecrets). To check an image before deploying use Operations → Image onboarding.
searchRegistriesHelp: Used, in order, for short names (e.g. "nginx"). Configured in /etc/containers/registries.conf.
noSearchRegistries: No search registry configured: always use fully qualified names.
configuredRegistriesHelp: Per-registry settings (mirrors, insecure or blocked registries) reported by Podman.
